rubric.title: Acceptance BAR — Cloud features — thorough end-to-end testing and verified shipment

criteria.title: Complete source-backed feature census

intent.request: Enumerate the exposed hosted cloud and GCP/AWS BYOC journeys, supported environments, route writers, dependencies, current acceptance evidence, and resource cleanup. Every census entry must have an assigned scenario and explicit result; unsupported provider options must fail closed rather than appear validated.

criteria.model: Enumerate the exposed hosted cloud and GCP/AWS BYOC journeys, supported environments, route writers, dependencies, current acceptance evidence, and resource cleanup. Every census entry must have an assigned scenario and explicit result; unsupported provider options must fail closed rather than appear validated.
criteria.bar: Enumerate the exposed hosted cloud and GCP/AWS BYOC journeys, supported environments, route writers, dependencies, current acceptance evidence, and resource cleanup. Every census entry must have an assigned scenario and explicit result; unsupported provider options must fail closed rather than appear validated.
criteria.method:
Inspect current hosted/BYOC route and UI writers; enumerate every documented cloud journey/provider/runtime in the P-001 scenario census, partition each into checked/notChecked/notApplicable, and verify each has test and cleanup evidence or an owned gap.

The pinned denominator is docs/evidence/cloud-e2e-campaign-2026-10-08.json population, sourced from the Acceptance population table at source07391377509dcbb7046a4c272441f73641f6d66d; the names SHA256 is43775d5b3628a192b40f15d33fd1425fcc0cde4dd59be0c0636be71f1dd41433. Execute cloud-e2e-campaign-evidence.test.ts to check verbatim source-population identity, canonical exact partition, supportedGCP/AWS/plannedAzure scope, and explicit fixture/native/live/deployed distinctions. R1 decides inventory completeness only: an owned gap accounts for an inventory entry but cannot establish functional coverage, real-runtime success, or shipment under R2-R6.
criteria.driftMarkers: A documented supported cloud journey, provider/runtime, required failure path or resource obligation has no scenario/result entry.
criteria.replication:
REPLICATION DRILL
Execute the maintained checker regression with `npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/cloud-e2e-campaign-evidence.test.ts`. Its pass is checker proof only. Then independently collect canonical source/test/provider/release records into the actual CloudCampaignEvidenceContext, set CLOUD_CAMPAIGN_CONTEXT to its retained path, and execute the runbook's exact Node evaluator command with R-1. Re-derive the Acceptance population table; compare verbatim names and names SHA, supported GCP/AWS/planned Azure scope, exact checked/notChecked/notApplicable partition and separately owned gaps. Falsify by dropping or duplicating one population member: the partition/population check must reject it. R1 proves inventory/disclosure only.

criteria.title: Persistent end-to-end coverage

intent.request: Cover sign-in and organization/workspace admission; setup and provider credential validation; configure and cost review; provision to healthy connection; launch and complete an agent task; desktop/browser interaction; stop/start and reconnect; snapshot and restore; repair and failed provisioning; billing/entitlements; tutorial pause/resume; destroy and resource accounting. Add missing regression scenarios in the project's actual test frameworks and affected-suite routing.

criteria.model: Cover sign-in and organization/workspace admission; setup and provider credential validation; configure and cost review; provision to healthy connection; launch and complete an agent task; desktop/browser interaction; stop/start and reconnect; snapshot and restore; repair and failed provisioning; billing/entitlements; tutorial pause/resume; destroy and resource accounting. Add missing regression scenarios in the project's actual test frameworks and affected-suite routing.
criteria.bar: Cover sign-in and organization/workspace admission; setup and provider credential validation; configure and cost review; provision to healthy connection; launch and complete an agent task; desktop/browser interaction; stop/start and reconnect; snapshot and restore; repair and failed provisioning; billing/entitlements; tutorial pause/resume; destroy and resource accounting. Add missing regression scenarios in the project's actual test frameworks and affected-suite routing.
criteria.method:
Run canonical API lifecycle tests and the real-component Cloud first-agent browser journey; inspect the resulting ledger rows, traces and affected-suite selection. Extend these suites for uncovered population entries.

The complete detector lookup population is the pinned campaign detectorMatrix, with exact file, full case title, recorded row and source identities. Load the unmodified canonical test-run records and current test-file fingerprints independently; evaluateCloudCampaignEvidence requires exact ledger id/source/file/title joins and measured affected selection. Every required happy-path mapping must pass. Unknown source binding, selection, collection, cases or ledger evidence is nonpass. The companion unit suite proves detector/ledger contradiction handling only; historical fixture/unit/database passes and lookup targets cannot by themselves establish R2 coverage.
criteria.driftMarkers: A supported happy-path journey lacks a persistent passing end-to-end or integration guard, or the affected suite does not select it.
criteria.replication:
REPLICATION DRILL
Execute the maintained checker regression with `npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/cloud-e2e-campaign-evidence.test.ts`. Its pass is checker proof only. Then independently collect canonical source/test/provider/release records into the actual CloudCampaignEvidenceContext, set CLOUD_CAMPAIGN_CONTEXT to its retained path, and execute the runbook's exact Node evaluator command with R-2. Read every happy detectorMatrix mapping's exact ledger id, file, full passed case title, source/test hashes, collection status and measured affected selection; execute the mapped maintained journey. A wrong row/source/title, absent selection or missing mapping must remain nonpass. Do not submit hypothetical ledger inputs.

criteria.title: Adversarial and recovery acceptance

intent.request: Verify unauthorized access, tenant/workspace switching, stale credentials, delayed or failed operations, retries and duplicate submission, idempotence, reload/reconnect, unavailable provider and transport, redaction, keyboard/accessibility, and cleanup after partial failure. Distinguish real provider outcomes from mocked HTTP or fake-provider coverage.

criteria.model: Verify unauthorized access, tenant/workspace switching, stale credentials, delayed or failed operations, retries and duplicate submission, idempotence, reload/reconnect, unavailable provider and transport, redaction, keyboard/accessibility, and cleanup after partial failure. Distinguish real provider outcomes from mocked HTTP or fake-provider coverage.
criteria.bar: Verify unauthorized access, tenant/workspace switching, stale credentials, delayed or failed operations, retries and duplicate submission, idempotence, reload/reconnect, unavailable provider and transport, redaction, keyboard/accessibility, and cleanup after partial failure. Distinguish real provider outcomes from mocked HTTP or fake-provider coverage.
criteria.method:
Execute isolation, unauthorized access, failure/retry, chaos and UI reload/permission scenarios; include at least one negative control per permission/lifecycle boundary and inspect sensitive output redaction.

Use the same pinned denominator with distinct adversarial mappings and requiredFailurePaths, including crash after provider creation before persistence, bounded timeout, long-running cancellation, leakage and billing cessation. Missing cancellation/control evidence is unknown/nonpass. Every permission/lifecycle boundary requires a measured caught negative control, not an authored caught flag. evaluateCloudCampaignEvidence rejects absent, uncaught or mismatched ledger cases. Its synthetic unit inputs test the checker only and cannot establish real provider R5.
criteria.driftMarkers: An unauthorized/duplicate/stale operation succeeds, recovery loses state, secrets leak, or a required failure/recovery scenario remains untested.
criteria.replication:
REPLICATION DRILL
Execute the maintained checker regression with `npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/cloud-e2e-campaign-evidence.test.ts`. Its pass is checker proof only. Then independently collect canonical source/test/provider/release records into the actual CloudCampaignEvidenceContext, set CLOUD_CAMPAIGN_CONTEXT to its retained path, and execute the runbook's exact Node evaluator command with R-3. Read every adversarial detector and requiredFailurePaths boundary, including long-running cancellation; retain actual negative-control command and caught assertion. Missing, uncaught or wrong-identity controls and skipped recovery paths must remain nonpass. Fixture failure/recovery evidence cannot prove real providers.

criteria.title: Verified durable repairs

intent.request: For each discovered in-scope defect, register and own the repair, isolate the root cause with differing predictions, fix the originating layer, add a recurrence guard, and re-run the affected journey. Out-of-scope residue must have an accountable owner.

criteria.model: For each discovered in-scope defect, register and own the repair, isolate the root cause with differing predictions, fix the originating layer, add a recurrence guard, and re-run the affected journey. Out-of-scope residue must have an accountable owner.
criteria.bar: For each discovered in-scope defect, register and own the repair, isolate the root cause with differing predictions, fix the originating layer, add a recurrence guard, and re-run the affected journey. Out-of-scope residue must have an accountable owner.
criteria.method:
For each defect inspect its work-item rootCauseVerification and originating source diff, execute its registered regression before/after and rerun the triggering scenario; verify residue assignees and cleanup obligations.

Read every id in the canonical defectPopulationRecords and outOfScopeResidue from work_items:get; load complete current completion evidence rather than trusting snapshot status. Reuse RootCauseVerificationSchema, missingRootCauseVerificationV2Fields and the canonical exact coverage partition. Each completed defect needs committed originating fix bytes, differing predicted observations, measured regression control and a passing rerun of its triggering journey; open residue needs the actual assignee. The campaign evaluator checks these independent joins. Snapshot bookkeeping and a green unit suite do not close an open defect or manufacture a triggering journey.
criteria.driftMarkers: A confirmed defect is closed without originating-layer fix, recurrence guard and passing triggering journey, or residue lacks an accountable assignee.
criteria.replication:
REPLICATION DRILL
Execute the maintained checker regression with `npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/cloud-e2e-campaign-evidence.test.ts`. Its pass is checker proof only. Then independently collect canonical source/test/provider/release records into the actual CloudCampaignEvidenceContext, set CLOUD_CAMPAIGN_CONTEXT to its retained path, and execute the runbook's exact Node evaluator command with R-4. Re-read every canonical discovered-defect and residue work-item with complete completion evidence and current assignee. Inspect the originating committed fix, differing root-cause predictions, registered recurrence guard and passing triggering journey. A proposed closure or open in-scope repair is incomplete; verify owned out-of-scope residue without treating ownership as a runtime pass.

intent.request: Run maintained current-build routes for operator API, hosted/browser, desktop, and provider lifecycle. Use isolated test organizations/accounts/resources and uniquely tagged canaries; preserve exact source/artifact identities, commands, assertions, provider receipts, logs and teardown evidence. A skipped or unavailable scenario remains unverified and prevents a universal pass.

criteria.method:
Use maintained isolated API/UI/native and real provider acceptance executors. Bind each result to source hash, served artifact, tenant/account and unique resource labels; inspect provider readiness, task completion, stop/start/snapshot/restore and destroy receipts. Retain evidence and separately flag mocks/skips.

Independently load actual maintained execution, artifact and provider records into evaluateCloudCampaignEvidence using the complete source-derived population and explicit operator-api/hosted/desktop-native/GCP/AWS obligations. Pin notBefore and now to the campaign evidence window; require exact source and artifact SHA, authenticated non-synthetic runtime, tenant/workspace/account/run/resource labels and every required action. Require provider-specific full-kind controller-independent census after execution and separate billing-closure evidence after census. Missing/skipped/unavailable, malformed, stale, wrong-identity or unmeasured input is nonpass. Unit contradiction tests exercise the schema only; no hypothetical fixture may discharge this live evidence plane.
criteria.driftMarkers: A real-runtime or provider result is inferred from mocks, identities differ, teardown is unproven, or a required supported runtime/provider path remains skipped.

Then independently collect canonical source/test/provider/release records into the actual CloudCampaignEvidenceContext, set CLOUD_CAMPAIGN_CONTEXT to its retained path, and execute the runbook's exact Node evaluator command with R-5. Use maintained current-build API/hosted/native/GCP/AWS routes and bind every action to the actual authenticated non-synthetic source/artifact, tenant/workspace/account/run/unique label. For GCP and AWS inspect controller-independent full-kind post-run census and separate later billing closure. Empty, mocked, stale or incomplete lifecycle/cleanup receipts must fail.

criteria.title: Exact shipped artifact

intent.request: After the applicable green promotion and deployment, verify cloud acceptance on the exact authenticated artifact serving the cloud app and applicable desktop/runtime artifact. Shipment requires the resulting source/artifact receipt, no unowned residue, a completion audit, plan-specific grading, and a verified owner report. Staging results alone do not meet this bar.

criteria.model: After the applicable green promotion and deployment, verify cloud acceptance on the exact authenticated artifact serving the cloud app and applicable desktop/runtime artifact. Shipment requires the resulting source/artifact receipt, no unowned residue, a completion audit, plan-specific grading, and a verified owner report. Staging results alone do not meet this bar.
criteria.bar: After the applicable green promotion and deployment, verify cloud acceptance on the exact authenticated artifact serving the cloud app and applicable desktop/runtime artifact. Shipment requires the resulting source/artifact receipt, no unowned residue, a completion audit, plan-specific grading, and a verified owner report. Staging results alone do not meet this bar.
criteria.method:
Read the authoritative exact deployed app/desktop artifact receipt and authenticated serving identity, execute final cloud smoke/journey acceptance on that artifact, verify promotion/deployment receipts, complete source audit/independent grading and report publication/readback.

Use evaluateCloudCampaignEvidence to join the actual green promotion, deployment and authenticated serving receipts to the exact promoted source/artifact and final execution on that same artifact. The final execution must occur after deployment and repeat the same required cloud task/reconnect/lifecycle/cleanup obligations used for R5, including full GCP and AWS lifecycle; a trivial smoke does not substitute. Require current completion audit, independent plan grade and verified report readback, with no unresolved inventory or defect residue and no earlier unmet BAR. Unit inputs test mismatched digest, source, authentication, time and grade rejection only; they cannot discharge the deployed evidence plane. Independent-axis examples: passing fixture detectors with no provider receipt fail R5 while leaving R2 detector proof distinct; valid candidate execution with wrong deployed digest fails R6; passing adversarial tests with an unverified discovered-defect repair fails R4.
criteria.driftMarkers: Plan is marked shipped from staging/fixture evidence, deployed artifact differs, final journey fails, or any required acceptance bar or owned residue remains unresolved.
criteria.replication:
REPLICATION DRILL
Run the maintained checker regression through testing:run {files:['packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/cloud-e2e-campaign-evidence.test.ts'],harness:'papercusp'} (or the runbook test:file command); this is unit checker proof only. Independently collect the canonical release journals, authenticated serving receipt, committed completion audits, exact current independent/audited plan scorecard, and reports:publish/get publication+complete readback into CloudCampaignEvidenceContext.shipment. Pin subject plan revision/contentHash and rubric revision/criteriaHash, author and audited work-item population. Preserve raw record refs, hashes and timestamps; do not infer the context from acceptanceEvidence. Match all five runtime obligations and every evidenceRef/digest, promotionRef, deploymentRef, servingRef/identity, auditRef, gradingRef and reportReadbackRef to those records. Green promotion precedes successful deployment; final authenticated same-artifact/tenant/account/run/label execution is strictly after matched deployment and no earlier than serving measurement. Audit, grade and owner-visible complete publication/readback follow the final journey. Run the runbook exact Node evaluator command with R-6 on the actual retained context. Falsify independently with wrong-but-nonempty refs, serving identity, absent/duplicated canonical records, red promotion, foreign tenant/artifact, pre-deploy final, proposed audit, current-plan/rubric hash mismatch, self/unverified/pending-audit grade and report digest/readback mismatch: R6 must fail while eligible R5 candidate proof remains distinct. Repeat every R5 required task/reconnect/lifecycle/cleanup journey on the shipped artifact. Unit inputs, candidate receipts, unmet prior BAR and unresolved residue never establish shipment.
